notes.title: Chores of Corruption now available for MacOS too!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that Chores of Corruption is now available on MacOS!
The game supports both Intel-based Macs as well as M1/M2 chips.

There is a 20% launch discount happening too until Monday afternoon

If you encounter any issues, please let us know through the Steam Forums or our official [url=https://discord.gg/cdz3Ank7s6]Discord[/url] directly!

notes.title: Chores of Corruption on SHMUP Fest and launch discount
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

After our launch we are now also participating in the SHMUP festival!
During our launch week - up until October 2nd - we are also having a 20% launch discount!

Checkout our [url=https://discord.gg/hcPGSWsh]Discord[/url] to share your runs and the leaderboard to compete against other players.

There has been a small update earlier today, read more about it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2438770/view/3719466676728163129?l=english]here[/url].


Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Chores of Corruption is in Early Access NOW!
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that Chores of Corruption is now available on Steam Early Access!
Choose one of our currently six characters and venture into the [i]Haunted Mansion[/i], unlock new items, weapons and upgrades that aid you on your journey through the Corruption!

While you are busy exploring, we will be looking out for any reported issues and prepare new content for future updates!
We have plenty of exciting things we want to put into the game during and beyond Early Access, and we can't wait to share them with you!
More details will follow soon.

Enjoy and please share the game with your friends ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Chores of Corruption: Pre-Release Patch Notes 4th of August 2023
notes.notes:
With our first week of our Pre-Release phase coming to an end and finally setting our store page live, we want to welcome everyone new to the game and try to push out patch notes and updates even before initial Early Access launch on a regular basis.

For this week's major updates and changes, please see the changelog below.

[list]
[*]leaderboards added
[*]improved enemy balancing
[*]added screen transition effects between waves
[*]weapon drops are now limited to boss fight rewards
[*]added logic to end the game after wave 25
[*]saw no longer destroys enemy projectiles
[*]added reroll mechanics to cards for testing
[*]replaced splash image with game key art
[*]added applogo icon
[*]fixed an issue preventing certain achievements from triggering correctly
[*]added new achievements
[*]improved character selection layout and details
[*]adjusted Rat King boss collider
[*]fixed an issue preventing the right focus when switching between mouse and gamepad in the upgrade selection screen
[*]fixed hpregeneration not calculating and triggering correctly
[*]changed Bandage item to increase passive healthregen instead of causing additional health drops
[/list]

We are providing pre-release keys for testing through our Discord and chat about upcoming changes and ideas all the time. If you want to be in, just join through our Discord link on our main store page.
